# Blossom Game

> Blossom Game (blossomgamez.com) is a free educational word puzzle website where players create words from seven letters arranged in a flower shape. Every word must use the center letter. The site offers daily and unlimited play, learning tips, and guides for students, parents, and teachers.

Blossom Game is a flower-style word puzzle (also searched as Blossom Word Game, Word Blossom, Blossom Puzzle, and Blossom Daily Word Game). Players combine petal letters with a required center letter to form valid English words, score points by word length, and hunt for pangrams that use all seven letters.

Primary audience: children, students, adult learners, parents, and teachers looking for vocabulary, spelling, and brain-training practice.

Playable game is embedded on the homepage. Legal pages (Terms, Privacy, DMCA) are noindex and should not be treated as primary content.

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://blossomgamez.com/): Main Blossom Word Game page with playable puzzle, how-to-play, features, benefits, tips, reviews, and FAQ
- [About Us](https://blossomgamez.com/about-us): Story, mission, and values behind the site
- [Contact Us](https://blossomgamez.com/contact-us): Contact form and support details
- [Blossom Word Finder](https://blossomgamez.com/blossom-word-finder): Free Blossom solver with hints
- [Spelling Bee Solver](https://blossomgamez.com/spelling-bee-solver): Unofficial NYT hive solver with spoiler-free hints and a letter grid
